Translations.graph_title: Real-time Frame Time History (Last 100 Frames) - Spikes indicate micro-stutters
Translations.help_ptr_a:
• 100% (Green): 1 sec in physics = 1 sec in real world.
• <80% (Yellow): Physics is lagging; game clock turns yellow and slow-motion occurs.
• <50% (Red): CPU physics thread is fully saturated; vessel simplification required.
Translations.help_1pct_q: What are 1% Low and 0.1% Low FPS?
Translations.help_1pct_a:
• 1% Low: The 99th percentile slowest frames. Indicates real-world stuttering. If Avg FPS is 60 but 1% Low is 15, the game will feel visibly jerky.
• 0.1% Low: Severe freeze spikes (usually caused by GC sweeps or burst operations).
Translations.help_jitter_a: • Standard deviation of frame times. Below 2ms is exceptionally smooth; above 6ms causes prominent tearing and uneven pacing.
Translations.help_mod_tuning_a:
1. Physics Lag: Install KSPCommunityFixes and avoid excessive AutoStruts.
2. GC Hitching: Use this mod's built-in [Mono Heap Padder] (Hotkey: Alt+End) to pad 2-4GB virtual heap, extending GC pause intervals from seconds to dozens of minutes.
3. GPU Lag: Tweak Scatterer / TUFX antialiasing and Parallax terrain tessellation settings.
